score_records.method: Computed each of the four official S1 QASM programs locally with Qiskit Aer double-precision statevector simulation, starting from |0000>, and evaluated Pauli Z on the qubit specified by its circuit ID (q0 is the rightmost Pauli character). Cross-checked every value with Qiskit Statevector. No shot sampling, fitting, or score-derived labels. BlueQubit compute cost: $0.

Computed each of the sixteen official S2 QASM programs locally using Qiskit Aer double-precision, noiseless statevector simulation. Each program starts in |0...0>; the reported value is the expectation of Pauli Z on q[q], with q0 the rightmost Pauli character. No shot sampling, extrapolation, fitting, or score-derived labels. BlueQubit compute cost: $0.

Local coefficient-cutoff Pauli propagation for each of the 30 public S3 QASMs. Qiskit optimization level 1 (u3/CZ basis); propagated target Z backward, merged identical strings, and removed coefficients below 0.01 after each gate. Summed I/Z-only terms on |0...0>. All runs completed within 100,000 terms. Validated the untruncated engine against independent small-circuit statevectors. No fitting or fusion. Independent implementation, not BlueQubit's PPS kernel. BlueQubit cost: $0.
